exposure: cesarean hysterectomy due to placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 51 patients who underwent cesarean hysterectomy due to placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) and 51 control patients who had an ordinary cesarean section at term.
finding: Patients undergoing cesarean hysterectomy due to PAS experienced significantly higher urinary incontinence symptoms and impaired sexual function compared to those undergoing an ordinary cesarean section.
mod_finding: Patients who underwent cesarean hysterectomy for PAS had a higher incidence of UI and impaired sexual function compared to those who underwent an ordinary cesarean section.
